title: Three Autumns and One Short Basket
subtitle: 自然生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）
meta: 主题语境：自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）　|　核心词汇：path　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 path 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the farmer ① followed the path that no child in the field would have noted, and he said the following was the whole of the autumn. The ② path, meaning the track itself and not the basket, ran three autumns and stayed unnoted in the book; a path, he said, is the only thing in a field that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ path in that field had the same short basket beside it, and the ④ path at the far fence, meaning the seed they kept for the children to sow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A path, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the farmer said the noting is the part that fills three autumns.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the path was the whole of the matter, meaning the direction and not the track. The ⑥ path, meaning the direction and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; path, he said, is either something you follow or the only word that means both a track and a direction. He said the direction is the part they remember.

By 1970 the ⑦ path had become a line in an almanac, and the almanac had become an argument about the short basket. The ⑧ path of the whole thing, the farmer wrote in September, was one field and three autumns of noting; path, he said, is either the seed at the far fence or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ path I remember is the track noted in the almanac, which closed in 1972 and is still noted as the quietest in the field. A ⑩ path, my mother said in 1974, is the only track that improves by being noted; every path, she said, is a direction that has agreed to look like a track. She said the direction was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 小路；路径（指田垄里每一条旁边的那一条）
B. n. 小路；路径（指那条小路本身，与小小的竹篮相对）
C. 固定搭配：follow the path 循这一条小路
D. n. 小路；路径（指留给孩子们播的那一把）
E. n. 小路之事（抽象总称，指一处田垄的小路之事）
F. n. 小路；路径（指农事历里写到、被记下的那一条）
G. n. 小路、去向（指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 去向（抽象总称，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: followed the path that no child in the field would have noted
The path, meaning the track itself and not the basket
the path at the far fence
the path was the whole of the matter
the path had become a line in an almanac
The path of the whole thing
A path, my mother said in 1974

answers.why: follow the path 意为“循这一条小路”，1965 年那位农人把田垄里没有一位孩子肯记下的一条小路做了一遍。
path 意为“小路；路径”，指那条小路本身而不是小小的竹篮，它经过了三个秋天而在簿子上没有被记下。
path 意为“小路；路径”，指田垄里每一条旁边的那一条，每一条旁边都有同一只小小的竹篮。
path 意为“小路；路径”，指最远那道篱边的留给孩子们播的那一把，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
path 意为“小路、去向”，指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这条去向就是那件事的全部。
path 意为“去向”，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西而不是那条小路，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
path 意为“小路；路径”，指农事历里写到、被记下的那一条，到 1970 年这一条成了农事历里的一行。
path 意为“小路之事”，农人九月写道，整件事的小路之事是一处田垄和三个秋天的记下。
path 意为“小路；路径”，我记得的是农事历里记下过的那一条，1972 年收完了，至今仍被说成田垄里最安静的一条。
path 为抽象总称，母亲 1974 年说，小路是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的小路。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1965 年那位农人循了田垄里没有一位孩子肯记下的一条小路，他说这一遍才是那个秋天的全部。（follow the path）
那条小路，指的是那条小路本身而不是小小的竹篮，经过了三个秋天而在簿子上没有被记下。（path）
那处田垄里每一条小路旁边都有同一只小小的竹篮。（path）
最远那道篱边那条小路，指的是他们留给孩子们播的那一把，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（path）
叔叔说这条去向就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那条小路。（path）

The path at the far fence, meaning the seed they kept for the children to sow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
